detail.title: Prime Distribution and the PNT
detail.summary: Continued focus on the Prime Number Theorem (PNT) and its characterization of prime distribution. The project remains in the research phase; while foundational questions about the PNT are established, current evidence consists of general bibliographic metadata. I will initiate a specific search for authoritative literature on the theorem's bounds and limitations to support a substantive notebook.

children.title: prime number theorem introductory exposition limitations distribution bounds

detail.reason: The project needs foundational, accessible literature to explain what the PNT states about prime density and, crucially, what it does not (e.g., error terms, local fluctuations), moving beyond generic metadata.
